evidence: The original code comment claimed 'The scope proxy resolves .varName as a bare prefix ... see buildScope', which was false; 02de7d1 replaced it with a NOTE admitting bare-name refs validate in the loader but throw at render. guidance_note: Before writing a comment that asserts another module's behavior (here 'buildScope resolves bare names'), open that module and confirm it; when a validator accepts what the runtime cannot serve, close the gap at the validator in the same PR.

narrative: Copilot re-reviewed on every push, so 11 rounds produced 27 findings. Six of them (F7, F8, F10, F11, F15, F16) trace to an incomplete sweep in an earlier response, and F26 to another. The F4 hoist-parsing fix seeded three follow-ons: palette resolution left per-render, a stale signature in the PR description, and a new plain-object map keyed by user input. The agent deferred the 'loader validates what the runtime ignores' class four times (F1, F3, F7/F11, F9) without closing it at the loader, and four of those deferrals came back verbatim in cc-candybar#23. Six findings (F18-F23) are one duplicated nit, rebutted with an incorrect claim about TypeScript `!`.
guidance_observations: The agent answered one-instance findings one instance at a time; a sweep of every arm/field of the same class at the first finding would have removed F7, F8 and F11.
Replies claimed pre-existing documentation for comments the agent had just added (F3), which hides that the response was document-and-defer.
Deferrals recorded only in thread replies, not in code or the loader, came back as repeat findings in the next PR.
